key_cards.contrastive_boundary: Exclude calendar appointments and generic time questions.
key_cards.definition: Commands that create, change, inspect, or remove alarms and wake-up reminders.
positive_examples: please set an alarm at six am
show me my alarms
remove alarm if any
teach children to never answer the door when home alone
cancel my eight am alarm

key_cards.contrastive_boundary: Exclude choosing music content and generic play or pause operations.
key_cards.definition: Commands that control audio volume, muting, or the active audio device.
positive_examples: hey turn the volume high
raise the volume of the speakers
turn the volume off
volume louder please
mute

key_cards.contrastive_boundary: Exclude wake-up alarms and task-list entries.
key_cards.definition: Commands that create, change, inspect, or remove calendar events.
positive_examples: how many meetings do i have today from nine to five pm
delete next event
set reminder for date night with husband next friday
what's the name of the event
open calendar

key_cards.contrastive_boundary: Exclude restaurant delivery and general factual questions.
key_cards.definition: Commands asking for recipes, ingredients, cooking steps, or cooking timers.
positive_examples: how long will it take to finish cooking my meal
what is a good substitute for butter
tell me the recipe for yellow rice
show me cooking websites
how long should i boil the eggs

key_cards.contrastive_boundary: Exclude alarms, calendar events, and weather forecasts.
key_cards.definition: Commands asking for the current date, time, day, or time in another place.
positive_examples: switch to los angeles time
what is the time difference between here and dakar
change mountain standard to pacific
tell me what time it is right now
current time please

key_cards.definition: Commands that read, search, compose, send, or manage email messages.
positive_examples: check email from john
read me the last email from stefan and oil change
i need to send an email to michael
between ten pm to nine am all emails received is to be replied to
what's his number

key_cards.contrastive_boundary: Use a specialist key whenever a specific domain is expressed.
key_cards.definition: General assistant-control commands and requests that do not fit a specialist domain.
positive_examples: what is the meaning of life
plan me a holiday trip
olly i am tired
what is my astrology report for today
let me know when charges hit my credit card

key_cards.contrastive_boundary: Exclude media playback and non-device factual questions.
key_cards.definition: Commands that inspect or control connected home devices, lights, heating, or appliances.
positive_examples: change the lights to red
turn all lights off during the day
turn the lights up
dim the lights
i can't see let's make it brighter

key_cards.contrastive_boundary: Exclude calendar events and reminders implemented as alarms.
key_cards.definition: Commands that create, inspect, change, or remove shopping and task list entries.
positive_examples: list things on my list
take joe of the list
can you please update me on my lists
can you remove the last list for me
forget this list

key_cards.contrastive_boundary: Exclude pure volume control and generic media transport controls.
key_cards.definition: Commands about songs, artists, albums, playlists, and music playback choices.
positive_examples: what is this song
i like the background song
please save this song to my favorites
please keep everything i have on this song
review

key_cards.contrastive_boundary: Exclude weather forecasts and open-domain factual questions.
key_cards.definition: Commands asking for news reports, headlines, or updates on current events.
positive_examples: whats going on in japan
i'd like news on donald trump
fire in columbus ohio
news updates
tell me about blank

key_cards.contrastive_boundary: Exclude selecting music content and changing audio volume.
key_cards.definition: Commands that start, pause, resume, stop, or navigate playable media.
positive_examples: go to the next episode
play last reason podcast
aib podcast on kashmirstart it
play some country music
play classical channel in sirius

key_cards.contrastive_boundary: Exclude recommendations and commands that operate a service or device.
key_cards.definition: Open factual questions seeking an answer rather than a device or service action.
positive_examples: what is the longest river in spain
when was albert einstein born
show me popular exchange rates
what is the point of a banana
when was frank sinatra born

key_cards.contrastive_boundary: Exclude direct factual questions and explicit takeaway orders.
key_cards.definition: Commands asking the assistant to recommend an option, place, or activity.
positive_examples: find events near by
what bands are playing close by
what events are happening in los angeles
where can i get something to eat by the art museum
what is there to do in new york city

key_cards.definition: Commands that read, compose, send, or manage social and instant messages.
positive_examples: tweet my complaint to @nsa
hello can you give the contact details for a particular service centre
write a complaint to best buy
tweet to the bbb that burger king is too expensive
will you please post this to my facebook i love you

key_cards.contrastive_boundary: Exclude cooking instructions and general place recommendations.
key_cards.definition: Commands for finding, ordering, or tracking prepared food for delivery or pickup.
positive_examples: order a pizza from pizza express
does chinese deliver
can i order takeaway from spanish place
please see if chili's has delivery
check the status of my order

key_cards.contrastive_boundary: Exclude weather and generic time questions.
key_cards.definition: Commands about routes, traffic, travel duration, public transit, or vehicle travel.
positive_examples: book a taxi to start from here
i need a taxi to pick me up at the house and take me downtown
can you call an uber for me
book a train for me
tell me all the distance locations and times

key_cards.contrastive_boundary: Exclude news, transport status, and generic date or time questions.
key_cards.definition: Commands asking for weather conditions, forecasts, temperature, rain, or wind.
positive_examples: is it hot outside right now im hawaii
please find today's forecast
is it going to snow today
is it going to be hot in two hours
can you let me know the weather of alabama tomorrow
